mongodb.init_bash: docker run -d --name mongodb -p $DB_PORT:$DB_PORT -v /data/db -e MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME=$DB_USER -e MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD=$DB_PASSWORD mongodb:latest

backend.cloudwatch_agent_init_bash: mkdir -p /home/ubuntu/cloudwatch-agent-deploy && aws s3 cp s3://$S3_BUCKET_NAME/static/main/monitoring/cloudwatch-backend.tar /tmp/cloudwatch-backend.tar && tar -xf /tmp/cloudwatch-backend.tar -C /home/ubuntu/cloudwatch-agent-deploy && chmod +x /home/ubuntu/cloudwatch-agent-deploy/install-cloudwatch-agent.sh && sudo env AWS_REGION=ap-northeast-2 LOG_GROUP_PREFIX=/ktb/prod /home/ubuntu/cloudwatch-agent-deploy/install-cloudwatch-agent.sh backend
backend.init_bash: docker run -d --name backend -p $BACKEND_PORT:$BACKEND_PORT -p $WS_PORT:$WS_PORT -e MONGO_URI=$MONGO_URI -e JWT_SECRET=$JWT_SECRET -e ENCRYPTION_KEY=$ENCRYPTION_KEY -e ENCRYPTION_SALT=$ENCRYPTION_SALT -e WS_PORT=$WS_PORT -e REDIS_HOST=$REDIS_HOST -e REDIS_PORT=$REDIS_PORT -e AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$AWS_ACCESS_KEY -e AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$AWS_SECRET_KEY backend:latest

frontend.init_bash: docker run -d --name frontend -p $FRONTEND_PORT:$FRONTEND_PORT -e NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=$NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL -e NEXT_PUBLIC_SOCKET_URL=$NEXT_PUBLIC_SOCKET_URL -e BASE_URL=$BASE_URL frontend:latest
